title.zh: 卷一百一十九 載記第十九 姚泓
title.raw: 卷一百一十九 載記第十九 姚泓 Volume 119 Records 19: Yao Hong

units.zh: 劉裕進據鄭城。
units.en: Liu Yu took Zheng.
units.literal: Liu Yu advanced and occupied Zheng city.

units.zh: 泓使姚裕、尚書龐統屯兵宮中，姚洸屯於灃西，尚書姚白瓜徙四軍雜戶入長安，姚丕守渭橋，胡翼度屯石積，姚贊屯霸東，泓軍於逍遙園。
units.en: Yao Hong sent Yao Yu and the minister Pang Tong to station troops in the palace, Yao Guang to garrison west of Feng, the minister Yao Baigua to move the mixed households of the four armies into Chang'an, Yao Pi to guard the Wei Bridge, Hu Yidu to garrison Shiji, Yao Zan to garrison east of the Ba, while Hong himself encamped at Xiaoyao Garden.
units.literal: Hong sent Yao Yu and Minister Pang Tong to camp troops in the palace, Yao Guang west of the Feng, Minister Yao Baigua moved four-army miscellaneous households into Chang'an, Yao Pi guarded Wei Bridge, Hu Yidu camped at Stone Accumulation, Yao Zan east of Ba; Hong encamped at Free-Roam Garden.

units.zh: 鎮惡夾渭進兵，破姚丕於渭橋。
units.en: Wang Zhen'e shattered Yao Pi at the Wei bridge.
units.literal: Zhen'e advanced troops on both sides of the Wei, defeated Yao Pi at Wei Bridge.

units.zh: 泓自逍遙園赴之，逼水地狹，因丕之敗，遂相踐而退。
units.en: Yao Hong's relief column stampeded itself in the narrow river flats.
units.literal: Hong went from Free-Roam Garden to aid him; pressed by water, ground narrow, because of Pi's defeat, they trampled each other in retreat.

units.zh: 姚諶及前軍姚烈、左衛姚寶安、散騎王帛、建武姚進、揚威姚蠔、尚書右丞孫玄等皆死於陣，泓單馬還宮。
units.en: Yao Chen; Yao Lie of the Vanguard; Yao Bao'an of the Left Guard; Cavalier Attendant Wang Bo; General Who Establishes Martial Might Yao Jin; General Who Displays Might Yao Hao; Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Sun Xuan; and the others all died in battle. Yao Hong rode back to the palace alone.
units.literal: Yao Chen and forward army Yao Lie, left guard Yao Bao'an, supernumerary Wang Bo, Jianwei Yao Jin, General Who Displays Might Yao Hao, right aide Sun Xuan and others all died in formation; Hong alone on horseback returned to the palace.

units.zh: 鎮惡入自平朔門，泓與姚裕等數百騎出奔于石橋。
units.en: Wang Zhen'e broke Pingshuo Gate; Yao Hong fled toward Stone Bridge.
units.literal: Zhen'e entered from Pingshuo Gate; Hong with Yao Yu and several hundred horse fled out toward Stone Bridge.

units.zh: 贊聞泓之敗也，召將士告之，眾皆以刀擊地，攘袂大泣。
units.en: Yao Zan's men wept and beat the ground when they heard the news.
units.literal: When Zan heard of Hong's defeat, he summoned officers and soldiers and told them; all struck the earth with knives, pulled sleeves and wept greatly.

units.zh: 胡翼度先與劉裕陰通，是日棄眾奔裕。
units.en: Hu Yidu defected to Liu Yu.
units.literal: Hu Yidu had earlier secretly communicated with Liu Yu; that day he abandoned the host and fled to Yu.

units.zh: 贊夜率諸軍，將會泓于石橋，王師已固諸門，贊軍不得入，眾皆驚散。
units.en: Yao Zan could not re-enter the sealed capital.
units.literal: Zan by night led all armies, planning to join Hong at Stone Bridge; the royal army had already secured all gates; Zan's army could not enter; the host all startled and scattered.

units.zh: 泓計無所出，謀欲降於裕。
units.en: Yao Hong decided to surrender to Liu Yu.
units.literal: Hong had no plan left, plotted wishing to surrender to Yu.

units.zh: 其子佛念，年十一，謂泓曰：「晉人將逞其欲，終必不全，願自裁決。」
units.en: His eleven-year-old son Yao Fonian said: "Surrender will not save us—better to die cleanly."
units.literal: His son Fonian, age eleven, said to Hong, "The Jin people will indulge their desires to the end—you will surely not be preserved whole; I wish to decide for myself."

units.zh: 泓憮然不答。
units.en: Yao Hong could not answer.
units.literal: Hong looked mournful and did not answer.

units.zh: 佛念遂登宮牆自投而死。
units.en: Yao Fonian leaped from the palace wall.
units.literal: Fonian then climbed the palace wall and threw himself down to die.

units.zh: 泓將妻子詣壘門而降。
units.en: Yao Hong brought his family to Liu Yu's camp and yielded.
units.literal: Hong led wife and children to the camp gate and surrendered.

units.zh: 贊率宗室子弟百餘人亦降於裕，裕盡殺之，余宗遷於江南。
units.en: Liu Yu slaughtered the surrendered Yao princes and deported the clan to the south.
units.literal: Zan led more than a hundred sons and nephews of the imperial clan also to surrender to Yu; Yu killed them all; the rest of the clan was moved south of the Yangzi.

units.zh: 送泓于建康市斬之，時年三十，在位二年。
units.en: Yao Hong was executed in the Jiankang market at thirty after two years' reign.
units.literal: They sent Hong to Jiankang market and beheaded him; he was thirty years old, on the throne two years.

units.zh: 建康百里之內，草木皆燋死焉。
units.en: Within a hundred li of Jiankang, grass and trees all scorched dead.
units.literal: Within a hundred li of Jiankang, grass and trees all scorched dead.

units.zh: 姚萇以孝武太元九年僭立，至泓三世，以安帝義熙十三年而滅，凡三十二年。
units.en: From Yao Chang's usurpation in the ninth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu to the fall in the thirteenth year of Yixi under Emperor An, the Later Qin lasted three reigns and thirty-two years.
units.literal: Yao Chang presumptuously rose in the ninth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu; down to Hong three generations; in the thirteenth year of Yixi under Emperor An they perished—thirty-two years in all.

units.zh: 史評
units.en: Section heading marking a later historical appraisal.
units.literal: Section heading marking a later historical appraisal.

units.zh: 史臣曰：自長江徙禦，化龍創業，巨寇乘機而未寧，戎馬交馳而不息，晦重氛於六漠，鼓洪流於八際，天未厭亂，凶旅實繁。
units.en: The historian opens: age of warlords and tribal armies without end.
units.literal: The historiographer says: From moving the defense to the Yangtze, transforming dragon and founding enterprise, great bandits seized the chance and were not yet quiet; war-horses galloped one upon another without rest; heavy murk veiled the six deserts, great floods drummed the eight bounds—Heaven had not tired of chaos, and fierce hosts were truly many.

units.zh: 弋仲越自金方，言歸石氏，抗直詞於暴主，闡忠訓于危朝，貽厥之謀，在乎歸順，鳴哀之義，有足稱焉。
units.en: Yao Yizhong defied Shi Hu yet sought peace—his loyalty earns praise.
units.literal: Yizhong crossed from the metal quarter, spoke of returning to the Shi house, raised straight words to a violent lord, spread loyal instruction in a perilous court—his plan for posterity lay in submission; the meaning of his lament is worth praising.

units.zh: 景國弱歲英奇，見方孫策，詳其幹識，無忝斯言，遂踐迷途，良可悲矣！
units.en: Yao Xiang matched Sun Ce in dash but marched into tragedy.
units.literal: Jingguo in weak years was heroic and strange, compared to Sun Ce; examining his capacity and insight, he did not shame that saying—yet he trod a lost road, truly lamentable!

units.zh: 景茂因仲襄之緒，躡苻亡之會，嘯命群豪，恢弘霸業，假容沖之銳，俯定函、秦；
units.en: Yao Chang took up Yao Xiang's legacy, stepped into Fu Jian's fall, whistled command to the heroes, enlarged the hegemon's enterprise, and borrowed Murong Chong's edge to settle Hangu and Qin.
units.literal: Jingmao took up Zhongxiang's thread, stepped into Fu's fall, whistled command to the heroes, enlarged the hegemon's enterprise—borrowed Chong's edge to bow and settle Han and Qin;

units.zh: 挫雷惡之鋒，載甯東北。
units.en: He broke Murong Chui's power and quieted the northeast.
units.literal: broke the point of Lei E, brought peace to the northeast.

units.zh: 在茲奸略，實冠凶徒。
units.en: In cunning he outdid every rival warlord.
units.literal: In these crafty stratagems he truly crowned the villains.

units.zh: 列樹而表新營，雖云效績；
units.en: He marked new camps with trees—passing as order.
units.literal: Planting trees to mark new camps—though called achievement;

units.zh: 薦棘而陵舊主，何其不仁！
units.en: Yet he trampled his old lord Fu Jian—heartless.
units.literal: pushing brambles to climb the old lord—how lacking in benevolence!

units.zh: 安枕而終，斯為幸也。
units.en: He died in bed—that was luck enough.
units.literal: To pillow in peace and end—this was fortune.

units.zh: 子略克摧勍敵，荷成先構，虛襟訪道，側席求賢，敦友弟以睦其親，明賞罰以臨其下，英髦盡節，爪牙畢命。
units.en: Yao Xing broke strong enemies, finished his father's work, sought wise counsel, knit his clan, and ruled with clear rewards—rivaling Zhuang of Chu or Mu of Qin.
units.literal: Zilue was able to crush mighty foes, bore the completed prior structure, emptied breast to visit the Way, set aside mat to seek worthies, thickly befriended younger brothers to harmonize kin, clarified rewards and punishments to face those below—heroes exhausted their integrity, claws and fangs gave their lives.

units.zh: 取汾、絳，陷許、洛，款僭燕而籓偽蜀，夷隴右而靜河西，俗阜年豐，遠安邇輯，雖楚莊、秦穆何以加焉！
units.en: At his height he held the heartland and the west in prosperity few could match.
units.literal: He took Fen and Jiang, fell Xu and Luo, treated false Yan as vassal and hedged false Shu, leveled Longyou and quieted Hexi—customs rich, years abundant, far quieted and near gathered—though Chu Zhuang or Qin Mu, how could they surpass!

units.zh: 既而逞志矜功，弗虞後患。
units.en: Then pride undid his caution.
units.literal: Yet afterward he indulged his will and boasted of merit, did not guard against later trouble.

units.zh: 委涼都於禿髮，授朔方於赫連，專己生災，邊城繼陷，距諫招禍，蕭牆屢發，戰無寧歲，人有危心。
units.en: He entrusted the Liang capital to Tufa and handed Shuofang to Helian, trusting himself bred disaster; border cities fell in succession, rejecting remonstrance invited calamity, inner-wall strife broke out again and again, war had no quiet year, and men lived in fear.
units.literal: He entrusted Liangzhou to Tufa, handed Shuofang to Helian, trusting himself bred disaster; border cities fell in succession, rejecting remonstrance invited calamity; inner walls rose again and again; war without quiet years, men harbored peril in heart.

units.zh: 豈宜騁彼雄圖，被深恩於介士；
units.en: He should have showered his soldiers with thanks—
units.literal: How fitting to ride those heroic plans and spread deep favor on armored men—

units.zh: 翻崇詭說，加殊禮于桑門！
units.en: —yet he lavished gold on Buddhist monks instead.
units.literal: yet he reversed course to honor crafty doctrine and piled special rites on shaven monks!

units.zh: 當有為之時，肄無為之業，麗衣腴食，殆將萬數，析實談空，靡然成俗。
units.en: He let monasteries swell while taxes bled the hills.
units.literal: In a time when action was needed, he practiced non-action's enterprise; gorgeous robes and rich food approached ten thousand; splitting substance they talked emptiness—became custom on the wind.

units.zh: 夫以漢朝殷廣，猶鄙鴻都之費；
units.en: Even the vast Han court scorned the waste of the Hongdu academy.
units.literal: Even Han's vast abundance still despised Hongdu's expense;

units.zh: 況乎偽境日侵，寧堪永貴之役！
units.en: How much less could a shrinking rebel realm bear endless monastic extravagance?
units.literal: how much more when false borders daily shrank—could it bear eternal costly service!

units.zh: 儲用殫竭，山林有稅，政荒威挫，職是之由，坐致淪胥，非天喪也。
units.en: Empty treasuries and forest levies—not fate but policy destroyed Later Qin.
units.literal: Stores were exhausted, hills and forests taxed; government wild, awe broken—this is the reason; sitting to bring ruin—Heaven did not destroy them.

units.zh: 元子以庸懦之質，屬傾擾之餘，內難方殷，外禦斯輟。
units.en: Yao Hong was weak when kin tore the realm apart and Jin struck.
units.literal: Yuanzi with a mediocre and timid substance, amid the aftermath of overturn and turmoil, inner disaster just raging, outer defense then ceased.

units.zh: 王師杖順，弭節而下長安；
units.en: Jin marched in righteousness and took Chang'an;
units.literal: The royal army wielded obedience, lowered the pace and descended on Chang'an;

units.zh: 凶嗣失圖，系組而降軹道。
units.en: the last heir bound himself at Zhidao.
units.literal: the wicked heir lost his plan, tied cord and surrendered at Zhidao.

units.zh: 物極則反，抑斯之謂歟！
units.en: Thus the wheel turns: extremes invite reversal.
units.literal: Things extreme then reverse—does this say it!

units.zh: 贊曰：弋仲剛烈，終表奇節。
units.en: Eulogy: Yao Yizhong was stern and fierce, and in the end displayed remarkable integrity.
units.literal: Eulogy says: Yizhong was stern and fierce, in the end displayed a strange integrity.

units.zh: 襄實英果，萇惟奸傑。
units.en: Yao Xiang was truly heroic and resolute; Yao Chang was a treacherous champion.
units.literal: Xiang was truly heroic and resolute; Chang alone was a treacherous champion.

units.zh: 興始崇構，泓遂摧滅。
units.en: Yao Xing first raised the frame; Yao Hong was then destroyed and extinguished.
units.literal: Xing first raised the frame; Hong then was destroyed and extinguished.

units.zh: 貽誡將來，無踐危轍。
units.en: Let later ages shun that fatal road.
units.literal: Leave warning to those who come—do not tread this perilous rut.

precedingContext.zh: 鎮惡遣毛德祖擊彊，大敗，彊戰死，難遁還長安。
precedingContext.en: Mao Dezu killed Yao Qiang; Yao Nan bolted for Chang'an.
precedingContext.literal: Zhen'e sent Mao Dezu to strike Qiang, greatly defeated him; Qiang died in battle; Nan fled back to Chang'an.
